en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard divided into two photographs. The upper image shows a rural landscape with fields, haystacks, fences and a small village with several houses and a church set against wooded hills. The lower image depicts a Marian grotto or shrine set into a rocky hillside, with a statue of the Virgin Mary in a niche and a fenced entrance gate labeled "MARIA-QUELL"; several women or girls in light dresses stand near the gate. In the center between the two images is printed text identifying the place as Ulrichsbrunn near Graz.
